value.rationale: Identity inputs give a canonical flat-spectrum rank-selection calibration. The theorem quantifies a meaningful and previously undocumented first-passage bias from repeated independent fresh residual probes: diverging sqrt(n log n) rank underselection, asymptotic strict accuracy miss, and a universal normalized overshoot constant. This is neither a renaming of a single chi-square tail nor a one-off finite computation; it addresses the algorithmic stopping rule itself.
